about.title: About me
paragraphs: Hi, I'm Dylan Ezequiel Gómez, a software developer passionate about creating unique, functional and high-performance digital experiences. I specialize in Full-Stack development, turning complex ideas into attractive, intuitive and fully responsive web and mobile applications, built with technologies like React, Node.js and TypeScript and always applying good architecture and SEO practices.
I am motivated by constant learning, exploring emerging technologies (such as Artificial Intelligence integration) to deliver innovative, efficient and scalable solutions.

Among my notable projects are S.I.A.T.E.C., a medical appointment management platform recognized at the 2025 Science and Technology Fair in San Vicente, Argentina, TRAVIO AI, an app that generates personalized travel itineraries with Artificial Intelligence, and Almacén Preciso, a mobile inventory management app for retail stores. These experiences allowed me to showcase my work at various events and connect with industry professionals.

I have the backing of my Computer Technician degree, which has given me a solid technical and logical foundation to successfully face any challenge in software development. I'm currently available for freelance projects and new opportunities.

list.title: TRAVIO AI | Web App
list.description: Full-Stack e2e web application that uses Artificial Intelligence (Gemini API) to generate fully personalized travel itineraries in seconds based on the user's budget and interests.

list.title: Almacén Preciso | Mobile App
list.description: Mobile app that streamlines operational communication between store owners and staff: report out-of-stock items instantly, approve or reject restocks with one tap, and track real-time metrics with push notifications.

list.title: 📰El Diario Sur
list.description: I collaborated on the development of SIA-TEC, a system to automate healthcare at primary care centers (CAPS). The project was highlighted by El Diario Sur due to its impact on the community and the optimization of medical shift wait times.

list.title: 💻CoreByte
list.description: I developed the Frontend architecture of this school application together with a teacher. The system allows teacher administration and enrollment of students in technology classes, prioritizing an intuitive interface for the user.
